description: KL320, said once on the first block: 474 new VFX where the game has room for 473, and 11 sounds in VFX where it has room for 10. The limits one at a time are in the unit tests.

diagnostics.message: This mod asks for 474 new VFX, and the game has room for 473 (2048 less its 1575); 11 sounds in VFX, and the game has room for 10 (16 less its 6): past a limit the game aborts, so Kiln refuses the mod that reaches it and none of its VFX load
